odata_version.title: OData Version
odata_version.description: OData protocol version. auto detects from $metadata (recommended); v2 for legacy SAP services, v4 for modern SAP services.

service_path.title: Service Path
service_path.description: Path to the OData service, appended to Base URL. Select from catalog or enter manually. Example: sap/opu/odata/sap/API_BUSINESS_PARTNER (V2) or sap/opu/odata4/sap/api_fixedassetacquisition/srvd_a2x/sap/fixedassetacquisition/0001 (V4).

entity_set.title: Entity Set
entity_set.description: OData entity set to extract data from (like a database table). Select from the list or enter manually. Examples: A_BusinessPartner, SalesOrderSet, ProductSet.

query_options.title: 🔍 Query Options (Optional)
query_options.description: Configure field selection, filters, expansion, and ordering

select_fields.title: Select Fields
select_fields.description: Specific fields to extract ($select). Leave empty to extract all fields. Reduces data transfer and API costs. OData docs

filter_expression.title: Filter Expression
filter_expression.description: Filter records using OData $filter syntax. Examples: Status eq 'Active', CreatedAt gt 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z, Price le 100 and Category eq 'Electronics'. OData docs

expand_properties.title: Expand Navigation Properties
expand_properties.description: Related entities to include in the response ($expand). Examples: Addresses, Items, Category. Expanded data is flattened into columns. OData docs

fetching_options.title: 🔄 Fetching Options
fetching_options.description: Configure how data is fetched from SAP OData API

fetch_type.title: Fetch Type
fetch_type.description: Full: extract all records on every run. Incremental: extract only new/changed records since the last run using a timestamp field filter. OData docs

incremental_field.title: Incremental Field
incremental_field.description: Timestamp field used to filter new/changed records ($filter={field} gt {last_run}). Common SAP fields: LastChangedAt, ModifiedOn, CreatedAt, SystemModstamp.

destination.title: 📥 Destination
destination.description: Configure output table and how data is loaded to Keboola Storage

output_table_name.title: Output Table Name
output_table_name.description: Custom name for the output table in Keboola Storage. Defaults to the entity set name if left empty. Example: business_partners, sales_orders.

load_type.title: Load Type
load_type.description: Full Load: replace the entire table on each run. Incremental Load: append/upsert new data using the primary key — requires a primary key for deduplication. Keboola docs

primary_key.title: Primary Key
primary_key.description: Field(s) that uniquely identify each record — required for Incremental Load (used for upsert). Common SAP keys: BusinessPartnerID, SalesOrderID, ProductID. Keboola docs

advanced_options.title: ⚙️ Advanced Entity Options (Optional)
advanced_options.description: Override pagination settings for this entity. Leave empty to use global defaults.

page_size.title: Page Size
page_size.description: Override the global default page size for this entity. Leave empty to use the global default.

max_records.title: Max Records
max_records.description: Override the global max records limit for this entity (0 = unlimited). Leave empty to use the global default.
